description: Expert knockout on a mixture of experts, and the forced route. At block 0 of the tiny Mixtral (4 experts, each token routed to 2) `clean` reads, at the prompts' 8 tokens, which slots did not choose expert e (`ne` of `expert_indices`, 1 or 0 per slot, swept over the four experts), the same mask for expert 4, which no slot holds (the null), how many slots chose e on each row (`eq`, summed over positions and slots), and the routing entropy of each token (`entropy` of `router_logits`, over `num_experts`). `knockout` scales every slot's weight by its mask, so expert e's slots add nothing to `routed_output` there; the routing at block 0 is the clean run's, since nothing before it changed, so the mask read in `clean` is this forward's. `null` scales by the null's mask, all ones, and must give the clean numbers to the bit. `forced` writes -1e9 into expert e's router logit, so the router chooses the next expert instead. Each scores the KL of the last token's next-token distribution from the clean run's. The masks are read at a static index, the 8 tokens every prompt has: an operand from another forward pairs with the write position by position.
